plant overview - GLE Aberdeen
Glacial Lakes Energy, LLC – Aberdeen was purchased in December 2019. GLE Aberdeen is located on the west side of Aberdeen. GLE Aberdeen currently produces about 49.0 million gallons of ethanol per year as well as modified distillers grains. GLE Aberdeen also buys producer direct corn.
